parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside under `Tests/` directories (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/MockHLSAVPlayer.swift` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockPlayer.swift`) and carry `Mock`-prefixed type names (`MockHLSAVPlayer.play`, `MockPlayer.play`), making them test-fixture mock stubs despite the pipeline reporting `is_mock=false` and `is_test=false`. The `fields_or_signature` arrays are empty and all structural evidence fields (`jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`, `differing_slots`) are `null`, so there is no grounded basis on which to propose a shared extraction. Consolidating two mock `play` stubs that serve distinct test doubles (`MockHLSAVPlayer` vs `MockPlayer`) would couple unrelated test fixtures and risk obscuring intentional per-mock behavioural differences. Preferring no-action is the correct conservative stance given the fixture context and absence of structural evidence.
